In this channel we strive to provide right techniques as well as healthcare education to our viewers in all physical issues.
Dr. Sandeep Bhardwaj (MPT in Neuro) is a recognized and highly skilled physiotherapist in India with over 17 years of experience - 
1.  All spine related Problems like - Slip Disc, Sciatica, cervical spondylitis, S.I. joint Pain, Ankylosing spondylitis etc.
2. expert in Curing Paralysis like - Brachial Plexus Injury, Facial Palsy, Hemiparesis etc.
3.  Child Problems like- Cerebral Palsy, Autism, Behavior issue with occupational therapy.
4.  Sports Injuries

All above problems are well cured at
 Ambe Physio Hospital,
3 Branches in Jaipur 
Narayan Vihar, Mahesh Nagar, Mansarovar
Dr.Sandeep Bhardwaj (PT)
Senior Consultant Physiotherapist
